title: JANUS Engine R0A — Axle-scale geometry freeze and first-principles flow budget

source_geometry.operating_interpretation: Use the 62.3 mm circular envelope as the first Axle-derived ring scale. The artistic coin relief is not itself treated as membrane area, pressure hardware or cryogenic hardware.
source_geometry.rotation_axis_assumption: Normal to the two circular faces, through the 6 mm thickness.

derived_geometry.important_boundary: Frontal disk area and face/rim envelope areas are geometric bounds only. Real active membrane area must be designed and measured separately, probably using lamellae, porous media or another high-area structure.

screening_assumptions.fresh_water_throughput_bound: Q_bound = A_frontal * v_water. This is a screening ceiling, not proof that a rotating disk actually processes a non-overlapping volume A*v each second.

run001_consistency_audit.reinterpretation: RUN-001 is retained as an aggregate-system screening point. At 2 m/s and 50% O2 capture, 100 L/s corresponds to about 16.4 independent 62.3 mm frontal-area equivalents, or one equivalent circular flow aperture about 252.3 mm in diameter.

hydrodynamic_screening_model.relation: DeltaP_screen ~= K * 0.5 * rho_water * v^2 with K=1 used only as a geometry-level screening coefficient
hydrodynamic_screening_model.warning: K is not measured for the Janus ring. Real DeltaP(Q,RPM) is a dominant unknown and must replace this screening relation.

design_consequence.primary: The Axle-scale 62.3 mm module is useful as an R0A test article but is too small to inherit the 100 L/s RUN-001 flow assumption as a single ring.
scale_paths: increase total independently exposed water-flow area
use multiple axial modules with separate fresh-water lanes
scale outer diameter toward the required aggregate aperture
use high-area lamellae / porous / hollow-fiber-like membrane geometry to raise active membrane area while separately proving fresh-water renewal
use external current or vehicle motion only if the corresponding hydrodynamic drag is charged to the energy budget
design_consequence.nested_ring_warning: Concentric rings sharing the same water parcel do not multiply fresh-water oxygen supply simply by ring count. Only independent water turnover or demonstrably renewed boundary layers may be counted.

next_measurements: DeltaP_water(Q,RPM) for the 62.3 mm Axle-scale test article
captured_O2_mg_s(Q,RPM) with independent inlet/outlet dissolved-O2 mass balance
real active membrane area and membrane pressure drop
next_gate: JANUS_ENGINE_SIM_HOWL_CASTLE_RUN_002: rerun self-drive using the 62.3 mm geometry as one module and explicitly scale the number or total area of independently supplied modules instead of assigning 100 L/s to one ring.
